A '''chief engineer''' worked in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], the [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="SLR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="LL">The ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'' scenario does not provide a time frame for Bossk's ambush, but the comic [[Lady Luck (comic story)|''Lady Luck'']] states that Calrissian won Cloud City in 1 ABY. Furthermore, the short story ''[[Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array]]'', which describes Raynor's last assassination attempt against Calrissian happening around six weeks after the sabacc match, reveals that the ambush happens within these six weeks.</ref> [[Dominic Raynor]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambled]] away the [[City/Legends|city]] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] against [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who became the new [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]]. Raynor hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], who went to Cloud City and set up a [[Ambush in Cloud City|trap]] for Calrissian. Bossk [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] some vital equipment, and, impersonating the [[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]], he reported that a primary [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] pod was about to break down; this failure would drop the floating city into the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]. Calrissian escaped through a nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], so the ambush was ultimately unsuccessful.<ref name="SLR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The chief engineer was mentioned in ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'', an online scenario written by [[Eric Cagle]] for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' collectible tabletop strategy game in [[October 8]], [[2004]].<ref name="SLR" />
